'''Takako Honda''' (Japanese: '''本田貴子''' ''Honda Takako'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}} and {{aniseries|HZ}}. 

==Biography==
Honda was born on August 14, 1972, in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress as an adult. She joined {{aniseries|PTS}} during [[M09|the ninth movie]], where she voiced [[Meredith]]. Her most notable role in that work, however, is the evil Pokémon Hunter [[J]] in {{aniseries|DP}}. Honda is currently affiliated with Office Osawa.
